Split complete. `core/src/openmtr/open_mtr_client.rs` was replaced by a directory module with five files:

| File | Lines | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `mod.rs` | 54 | `OpenMtrClient` struct, `MtrResult` alias, `OpenMtrClientBuilder` re-export, core inherent methods (`from_parts`, `builder`, `system_name`, `access_token`), module declarations |
| `builder.rs` | 167 | `OpenMtrClientBuilder` + all methods, `build`/`build_with_transport` |
| `ops.rs` | 198 | All 21 operation methods |
| `exec.rs` | 69 | `exec_lote` + `normalize_error` |
| `tests.rs` | 97 | Determinism tests (verbatim bodies, re-imports added for moved scope) |

All files are well under the 300-line limit. Behaviour, public API, doc comments, and test assertions are unchanged; the old `.rs` file was deleted to avoid E0761. `cargo check -p open-mtr-core --tests` passes cleanly.
